decisions.decision: FileRotatingWriter opens via Darwin.open(O_WRONLY|O_APPEND|O_CREAT|O_CLOEXEC, 0o644) instead of FileHandle(forWritingTo:)
decisions.rationale: FileHandle(forWritingTo:) doesn't set O_CLOEXEC; long-lived log FD then leaks across fork+exec, which made ChildSpawnGate fatal-error in Debug on first MCP helper spawn. Bonus: O_APPEND removes the seekToEnd race window in the rotator.

decisions.decision: ChildSpawnGate.prepare() is now path-aware: fatal in Debug ONLY for FDs whose F_GETPATH is under our developer-owned prefixes (Bundle.main.bundlePath, ~/Library/Logs/Jarvis, ~/Library/Application Support/Jarvis); retrofit + log everything else
decisions.rationale: WebKit's GPU process opens system Metal libraries (e.g. AppleMetalOpenGLRenderer.bundle/default.metallib) without O_CLOEXEC, and Cmd-R from Xcode inherits lldb debugger pipes. Neither is actionable from our codebase. The pre-fix gate fatal-errored on these and prevented any MCP helper spawn from succeeding.

decisions.decision: Vite HUD bundle uses IIFE format with stripModuleAttrs plugin replacing type=module + crossorigin with defer
decisions.rationale: Vite default ES-module output triggers CORS-mode fetching that fails on file:// null-origin. Observed: index.html loaded but JS bundle failed with type=2/code=0 resource error. IIFE drops the module-fetch contract, defer restores parse-then-execute order so React's getElementById('root') finds the div. Trade-off: IIFE forbids code splitting + chunked dynamic imports — for a single-page R3F HUD this is fine.

decisions.decision: MenuBarIconController uses statusItem.popUpMenu(contextMenu) instead of toggle-menu-then-performClick pattern
decisions.rationale: The previous pattern temporarily assigned statusItem.menu, called sender.performClick(nil), then cleared. NSStatusItem could latch the menu reference on a separate runloop pass, after which both left- and right-clicks would surface the menu and the HUD-summon left-click action never fired. popUpMenu shows the menu for the current click only — no persistent state. Deprecated since 10.14 but functional through Tahoe.

decisions.decision: JarvisHUDPanel WKWebView.isInspectable=true behind #available(macOS 13.3, *) + clear container + webView layer.backgroundColor
decisions.rationale: Layer-clear is belt-and-braces against future macOS ignoring _drawsBackground SPI. isInspectable enables right-click Inspect Element on Debug builds, which was load-bearing for diagnosing the white-HUD issue (proved page WAS reaching renderer, body-color showed when forced).
